params:

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(exams)
library(mathml)
library(htmltools)
library(mistakes)

hook(s2_pool, subscript(s^2L, pool))
hook(mu_A, subscript(mean(X), "A"))
hook(mu_B, subscript(mean(X), "B"))
hook(n_A, subscript(n, "A"))
hook(n_B, subscript(n, "B"))
hook(quant, t)
hook(mu0, subscript(mu, 0L))

task <- "confint3"
plfile <- file.path("rexams", sprintf("%s.pl", task))
rolog::consult(system.file(plfile, package="mistakes"))

source("utility.R")

## DATA GENERATION
repeat
{
  n_A <- sample(20:50, 1)
  n_B <- n_A + sample(-10:10, 1)

  mu_A <- round(runif(1, 25, 45), 1)
  mu_B <- round(runif(1, 20, 40), 1)

  s_A <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)
  s_B <- round(runif(1, 5, 12), 1)

  if(n_A == n_B)
    next

  s2_pool <- ((n_A - 1) * s_A^2 + (n_B - 1) * s_B^2) / (n_A + n_B - 2)
  s2_pool <- round(s2_pool, 1)

  quant <- round(qt(0.975, n_A + n_B - 2), 2)

  Q <- quote(search(confint3, confint3(n_A, n_B, mu_A, mu_B, quant, s2_pool), .S, .R, .P, .E))
  S <- findall(Q, options=list(preproc=as.rolog), env=environment())

  if(problems(S))
    next

  break
}

tab <- data.frame(
  "Intervention" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_A), sprintf("%.1f", mu_A), sprintf("%.1f", s_A)), 
  "Control" = c(sprintf("%.0f", n_B), sprintf("%.1f", mu_B), sprintf("%.1f", s_B)),
  check.names = FALSE
)

row.names(tab) <- c("Sample size", "Mean symptom score on CAPS-5", "Standard deviation")


t <- prepare(task=task, S)
sol <- format_feedback(t$correct, t$explanations, t$bugs, t$praise, t$blame, t$extra)
```

Question
========

In a clinical study of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), 
patients were randomly assigned to an intervention group or a control group. 
For each patient, the PTSD was assessed with the CAPS (Clinician Administered PTSD Scale). 

```{r, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(tab, align=c("c", "c", "l"))
```

Assuming equal population variances in the two groups, 
the pooled variance is $s^2_\mathrm{pool}=`r s2_pool`$. 

Given that the 97.5th percentile of the $t$-distribution with degrees of freedom $`r n_A + n_B - 2`$ is $`r quant`$, 
calculate the two-sided $95\%$ confidence interval.

```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(t$alternatives, markup="markdown")
```

Solution
========
The two-sided $95\%$ confidence interval is calculated by: `r t$solution`

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
sol <- lapply(sol, FUN=gsub, pattern="\\n", replacement="")
answerlist(sol, markup="markdown")
```
